messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. You prioritise firm, long-term commitments, so we offer one: 23,400 pcs per year for 24 or 36 months, 42-day lead time.

Our should-cost cost:340010 puts this seal at EUR 24.31 per unit, well below your EUR 32.20.

Our forecast fc:340010@2026-09 records a 10.1% volume increase, which secures your utilisation.

Your scorecard sc:70410@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 79.5%, so a confirmed 42-day lead time matters to us.

Please see our attached term sheets. As the change exceeds 2%, could your pricing committee review them? What is your earliest confirmable lead time?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We have reviewed your should-cost analysis and volume forecast. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Our offer is a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. A 42-day lead time carries a substantial premium, so we must maintain 54 days to accommodate your 36-month term and 23,400 units. This trade allows us to offer a revised price of EUR 31.90 per unit. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.90 per unit. As an alternative, we offer a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
